slides.title: Four messy nests
slides.text: Behind the post office, Pim finds four messy nests built by the Magpie. Each nest holds a trick, and each trick has a motive.

slides.title: Keys and prizes
slides.text: The key-hunter wants into your mailbox, so its letters beg for your key. The prize-faker wants you to tap and type, so it dangles a fake reward.
slides.alt: The debrief: checking an account never needs your key sent in a letter. Behind this one: the key-hunter, who wants into your mailbox.

focus.cue: The key-hunter wants into your mailbox

slides.title: Reactions and shares
slides.text: The giggler wants a reaction, so it sends teasing tricks to make you reply fast. The forwarder wants you to share its trick with all your friends.
slides.alt: A post from News Flash: school is closing forever, free candy for everyone on Monday, tell everyone you know! Every clue marked: it only wants a big reaction.

focus.cue: Huge news from a sender nobody knows
Tell everyone: the giggler wants a big reaction

slides.title: Name the motive
slides.text: Pim finds a card that cries: tap here and type your name to claim your prize! Name its motive before you judge the card.
steps: It wants a tap and typing
slides.alt: A letter from Prize Team, “Visitor number 1000!”, with clues marked: visitor number 1000, and your free games console.

focus.cue: A prize to claim with one tap
Name the motive before you choose

slides.title: Starve the trick
slides.text: Knowing the motive tells you the defense: starve it. Do not reply, do not tap, and do not share, and the trick gets nothing it wanted.
slides.alt: A letter from Lucky Letters, “The shiny chain”, with clues marked: pass this letter to ten friends; a shiny surprise will find you; tonight.

focus.cue: A chain only works if you pass it on
Do not share: the chain ends with you

words.means: not real, but made to look real
something good you get for doing something
what you do or feel in reply to something

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Trick Inbox at Magpie Mix and sort all 6 messages. Before you choose, name the motive: key-hunter, prize-faker, giggler or forwarder.
slides.alt: The debrief: you did not enter anything, so you cannot have won anything. Behind this one: the prize-faker, who wants you to tap and type.

focus.cue: Play Magpie Mix: name the motive behind each
